name: element.update
title: Update element
summary: Change title, text or properties of one element. Unknown properties are kept, and unset removes one (#189); status changes only via element.setStatus, and the origin of an imported element only via reqif.import (SR-057).
whileReadOnlyReason: Changes an element file, and no change can be checked against a missing or faulty metamodel.

text.description: New Markdown text of the element; the blank line after the closing `---` is not part of the text, so the text element.get gives can be passed back unchanged. A changed text gets a final line break (ADR-0004). Another element is named by a Markdown link, `[Title](reqseq:N-6010df)` with its UUID, short ID or identifier, which is written as UUID and version; `reqseq:N-6010df` alone is no link and counts for nothing.

setItems.description: List items by position from 1: 1..n replace, n+1.. append; other items keep their bytes. Needs expectedFileSha256.

addRelations.description: Relations to add by kind, as relation.add adds them, in the same file write (#175). A relation the element has with a valid version is kept.

removeRelations.description: Relations to remove by kind, as relation.remove removes them (a UUID as given), in the same file write (#175). Nothing to remove is an info problem relation.not-found.

repository.description: Which of the elements ref names is meant: the workspace name of its repository, as details.candidates of ref.ambiguous give it (for example one copy of a file whose UUID another file shares, SR-088; #255). Only the elements ref names count; when none of them lies there, the error is ref.unknown with them as details.candidates.

expectedFileSha256.description: Write precondition (SR-106): the fileSha256 the change was made on, from element.get. Required with title, text or setItems, else input.invalid (precondition-missing); optional for set, unset and relations alone. If the file has other bytes now, nothing is written: file.changed-on-disk, also when nothing would change.

fileSha256.description: Of the file as written, or as read when nothing changed (SR-106).

affected.description: The number of directly affected elements (SR-024 AK2): the distinct elements other than this one whose files hold a relation or an inline reference to it, the elements at distance 1 of `trace.affected`. Counted only when the save changed what the version is computed from in normal form n1 or n2 (the content, D-013, ADR-0005), so also when it changed only the stored version of a reference: a link that stores n1 of this element becomes outdated by it; 0 when only the title or properties that do not count to the version changed, or nothing changed (SR-024 AK3). For an element without a version (a value that counts has no normal form, ADR-0005) what the version is computed from is compared, so a save of only its title or status also gives 0 (#276).
